description: Ministry of Skills Department, Employment & Labour Relations - Cease the Interpritation: Ansell Lanka (pvt.) Ltd. Vs. Free Trade Zones & General Services Employees Union
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under Section 20 of the Industrial Disputes Act. It is a formal legal notice published by the Commissioner General of Labour, detailing the statutory process for declaring that an arbitration interpretation will cease to have effect. The core subject matter is the operation and application of a specific labor law, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
